purpose: The exact host actions, responses and event-feed entries the production shell host (scripts/vh-codex-first-shell.mjs) exposes for the Codex daily-use parity gaps. The browser codes against these verbatim; every value comes from the app-server or from host session state, never from the browser.

transport.actions: POST /api/action with a JSON body { action, ...params }; success is { ok: true, data }, refusal is { ok: false, error: { code, message, ...details } } with the HTTP status named per action
transport.events: GET /api/events?after=<cursor>; host entries are { sequence, kind, value, observedAt }; app-server notifications arrive as kind notification with value { method, params } unchanged

bootstrap.threads[].settings: null until the runtime reported this Thread's settings, else { model, effort, approvalPolicy, sandboxPolicy, source, observedAt } (also on pinned[], recents[] and projects[].threads[])
bootstrap.queues: [{ threadId, paused, pausedReason, lastError, limit, items: [{ queuedId, queuedAt, settings, starting, input }] }] for every Thread with queued follow-ups; media inputs elided as { type, elided: true, byteLength, detail? }
bootstrap.preferences: { notifications: { mode: always|unfocused|never, modes: [always, unfocused, never], transient: true } }; default unfocused, absent after a host restart

settingsRecord.shape: { model: string|null, effort: string|null, approvalPolicy: untrusted|on-request|never|null, sandboxPolicy: SandboxPolicy|null, source: thread/start|thread/resume|thread/settings/updated, observedAt: ISO-8601 }
settingsRecord.sources: thread/start and thread/resume responses (model, reasoningEffort, approvalPolicy, sandbox); thread/settings/updated threadSettings (model, effort, approvalPolicy, sandboxPolicy)
settingsRecord.delivery: newThread.thread.settings, readThread.settings, startTurn.settings, every Thread record in bootstrap, and the forwarded thread/settings/updated notification; the host emits no event of its own for settings
settingsRecord.runtimeTruth: 0.149.0 sends thread/settings/updated only when a turn/start or turn/steer carried overrides that changed the effective settings; a plain thread/start sends none

turnSettings.shape: { model?: string (the Model.model slug, not Model.id), effort?: string (a supportedReasoningEfforts[].reasoningEffort of that model), approvalPolicy?: untrusted|on-request|never, sandboxPolicy?: { type: dangerFullAccess } | { type: readOnly, networkAccess?: boolean } | { type: workspaceWrite, networkAccess?: boolean, writableRoots?: string[], excludeSlashTmp?: boolean, excludeTmpdirEnvVar?: boolean } | { type: externalSandbox, networkAccess?: restricted|enabled } }
turnSettings.effect: sent as the exact turn/start keys; the app-server applies them to this Turn and subsequent Turns and answers with thread/settings/updated when they changed

variants.text: { type: text, text: non-empty string, text_elements?: [{ byteRange: { start, end }, placeholder?: string }] } — each byteRange is a UTF-8 byte span inside text; with a placeholder, Buffer.byteLength(placeholder) must equal end - start and the bytes at the range must equal the placeholder; ranges must not overlap or cut a character
variants.image: { type: image, url: data: URL of at most 12 MiB, detail?: auto|low|high|original }
variants.audio: { type: audio, url: data: URL of at most 12 MiB }
variants.skill: { type: skill, name: string (≤256), path: string (≤4096) } — from listSkills.skills[].name and .path
variants.mention: { type: mention, name: string (≤256), path: string (≤4096) } — from searchFiles.files[].file_name and .absolutePath (or .path, root-relative)

inputs.never: localImage and localAudio are never produced: a browser File carries no filesystem path

listModels.response: { models: [{ id, model, displayName, description, isDefault, defaultReasoningEffort, supportedReasoningEfforts: [{ reasoningEffort, description }], inputModalities: [text|image|audio] }] }
listModels.rules: hidden models are never listed; a record without inputModalities carries the pinned schema default [text, image]; send Model.model back as turnSettings.model

readThread.response: { thread: thread/read Thread with turns, settings: settingsRecord|null }

startTurn.request: { action: startTurn, threadId, input: inputs[], settings?: turnSettings } (model, effort, approvalPolicy, sandboxPolicy are also accepted at the top level)
startTurn.rules: resumes a Thread not loaded into this process generation first; the host records the Turn as live

steerTurn.request: { action: steerTurn, threadId, expectedTurnId, input: inputs[] }
steerTurn.rules: unchanged: the exact expectedTurnId, never the default while a Turn streams

queueTurn.request: { action: queueTurn, threadId, input: inputs[], settings?: turnSettings }
queueTurn.response: { queuedId, started: null | { queuedId, turnId }, queue: queueRecord (full media) }
queueTurn.rules: appends to the Thread's host-owned queue (409 queue_full beyond 20); when no Turn is live and the queue is not paused the head starts at once and started names its Turn

updateQueued.request: { action: updateQueued, threadId, queuedId, input: inputs[], settings?: turnSettings|null }
updateQueued.rules: settings omitted keeps the item's settings, null clears them; 409 queued_not_found, 409 queued_starting while the item's turn/start is in flight; served without the runtime

deleteQueued.rules: an emptied queue is never left paused; served without the runtime

resumeQueue.rules: clears the pause; with no Turn live the head starts at once, otherwise after the live Turn's turn/completed

steerQueued.rules: the queued input leaves the queue and steers the exact live Turn through turn/steer; a refused steer keeps it queued

interruptTurn.rules: pauses a non-empty queue with pausedReason interrupted

compactThread.rules: 409 turn_live { threadId, turnId } while a Turn is live (the host's record, then thread/read status active); the compaction runs as its own Turn whose contextCompaction item is the transcript boundary; thread/tokenUsage/updated follows

searchFiles.response: { query, root, limit, total, files: [{ root, path, file_name, match_type: file|directory, score, indices, absolutePath }] }
searchFiles.rules: fuzzyFileSearch rooted at the bound repository with a fresh cancellationToken per request; an empty query asks nothing; query ≤ 256 characters

listSkills.response: { cwd, skills: [{ name, path, description, shortDescription, enabled, scope, cwd }], errors: [{ path, message, cwd }] }
listSkills.rules: skills/list with cwds [repository]; disabled skills are listed with enabled false

setNotificationPreference.rules: host memory only; served without the runtime; 400 for any other mode

setThreadName.rules: unchanged; thread/name/updated { threadId, threadName } follows in the event feed

queueRecord.shape: { threadId, paused: boolean, pausedReason: null|interrupted|turn_failed|runtime_exited|start_failed, lastError: null|{ queuedId, message, observedAt }, limit: 20, items: [{ queuedId, queuedAt, settings: turnSettings|null, starting: boolean, input }] }
queueRecord.lifecycle: host-owned transient state per Thread, like pendingRequests: it survives browser route changes and reloads, and is lost on a host restart; never written to the browser or the repository
queueRecord.dequeue: on turn/completed with status completed the host starts the head as its own turn/start with a Turn id the runtime mints, one at a time; status interrupted or failed pauses the queue; nothing is sent after turn/interrupt until resumeQueue

hostEvents.queueChanged: { threadId, queue: queueRecord (elided media) } after every change, including automatic starts
hostEvents.queuedStarted: { threadId, queuedId, turnId } when a queued follow-up became its own Turn
hostEvents.queuedFailed: { threadId, queuedId, error } when its turn/start was refused; the item stays at the head and the queue is paused with pausedReason start_failed
hostEvents.clientAction: { action: compactThread|steerQueued|steerTurn|setNotificationPreference, ... } as for the existing actions

forwardedNotifications.thread/settings/updated: { threadId, threadSettings: { model, effort, approvalPolicy, sandboxPolicy, ... } } — note effort, not reasoningEffort
forwardedNotifications.thread/tokenUsage/updated: { threadId, turnId, tokenUsage: { total: { totalTokens, inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens }, last, modelContextWindow: number|null } } — inside a Turn before its turn/completed, and replayed on thread/resume; show no value before the first one and no percentage while modelContextWindow is null
forwardedNotifications.thread/compacted: { threadId, turnId } forwarded if ever sent; the 0.149.0 v2 path does not send it, the contextCompaction item does the work
forwardedNotifications.turn/started, turn/completed: unchanged. turn/started for a Thread the last bootstrap did not list (a brand-new Chat: 0.149.0 lists a Thread only once its first userMessage is durable, about 0.4 to 1.2 s after turn/started) keeps the browser's own record as a provisional row with the live dot and starts a bounded retry of at most 4 bootstrap refreshes 750 ms apart that ends the moment a bootstrap lists the Thread; turn/completed for a Thread still unlisted refreshes too
forwardedNotifications.item/completed: { threadId, turnId, item, completedAtMs } unchanged; the userMessage item of a Thread under that watch is the durable listing cue: the lists are refreshed from bootstrap at once
forwardedNotifications.thread/status/changed: { threadId, status } applied to every local row as the runtime's own status, so the dot settles on idle without a refresh; its active variant lands with turn/started, before the durable write, so it is no listing cue
